name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak reached 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 deaths by 11 Nov; Kenya and Nigeria hit in October
state: ECDC's update of 13 Nov reports 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 deaths in DR Congo, with data to 11 Nov and community transmission ongoing (ECDC). UKHSA's report for the week to 8 Nov puts the national average at 65–67 new cases a day, with North Kivu now ahead of Ituri. Kenya (nine cases, two deaths) and Nigeria (one case, 20 Oct) were affected in October; Uganda's outbreak ended on 27 Aug. Cases far exceed the 1,000 Alert line.
for_you: Travellers to DR Congo and neighbouring countries should follow FCDO travel advice and UKHSA guidance. UKHSA rates the risk to the UK population as low; WHO rates it very high in DR Congo.
rubric_hit: More than 1,000 cases: 11,197 confirmed (ECDC, data to 11 Nov) > 1,000 Alert line
basis_detail: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts
basis_by: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Ebola cases in DR Congo pass 11,000, with 5,387 deaths

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
